description: List the Earth-observation collections (datasets) in Microsoft's Planetary Computer STAC catalogue, with each one's licence, spatial extent and date range. PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH when asked which satellite, climate or land-cover datasets are available for an area or period — this is the operator's own live index, not a blog list. Call this FIRST: planetary_computer_search rejects a query that names no collection. Filter with `contains` (matches id, title and description, e.g. "landsat", "elevation", "fire").

contains.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against collection id, title and description (e.g. "sentinel", "climate", "biodiversity"). Omit to list the whole catalogue.

prefix.description: Only collections whose id starts with this (e.g. "landsat-").

name: planetary_computer_collections
title: Planetary Computer Collections
